caption:
One of the world’s most powerful tales of love and and treachery has just landed in Leeds ✨

We were lucky enough to attend the opening and WOW. The show has some of the most recognisable music on the planet and the atmosphere was electrifying 🎶 

For one night only you can enjoy it for as little as a fiver 🤯

On Wednesday 28th October, it’s “Pay What You Can” to see Opera North’s take on Rigoletto, so ideal for opera newbies 🖤 

You decide the ticket price, anything from £5 upwards to see one of Verdi’s most famous shows about an obsessive and loving father’s complex double life.

We also nipped in to enjoy a meal at neighbouring Yuzu street food beforehand for some East Asian nibbles and cocktails 🍸 🤭 (think katsu, bao buns and oodles of steaming donburi) which veryyyy nicely set us up for the show 👀 

#leeds #leedscitycentre #opera #thingstodoinleeds #rigoletto *pr invite

For some of us, Leeds is more than just a city.

It is where our real story began, where some of our best memories were made…

And it’s the place we call home ❤️ 

Thank you so much to the talented @leeds_mallutraveller for allowing us to use this stunning footage 📸 and to the lovely @madeleinerann for her contributions as always ❤️ 🥹

#leeds #home #leedslife #visitleeds #yorkshire

Who thinks they could take down a whooole giant lemon meringue pie by yourself? 🤭 🥧 🍋 

We weren’t sure whether to climb it, eat it or adopt it.

It’s good luck getting through even one slice of this gigantic crumbly lemon meringue pie - being served now @the.brick.yard 

An EPIC dessert and fast becoming one of the most famous in town ✨ 

This place was an absolute taste sensation from start to finish ✨ We also tried some of their mouthwatering new Autumn dishes including:

🥚 Gooey scotch egg with walnut ketchup 
🥘 Melt in your mouth lamb
🐟 Monkfish w braised hispi cabbage (the showstopper imo but then again there were too many to count 🤤)

Whatever you do - make room for that dessert.

Inspired song choice by @_lifeinleeds #leedsfood #brighouse #yorkshirefoodguide #leeds #lemonmeringuepie

But it’s not just any pumpkin patch 🚜 ✨🍁 

It’s a gorgeous family-owned farm which has been transformed into an autumnal oasis starring a gigantic pumpkin pyramid, the friendliest piggies 🐽 & the cutest marshmallow and coffee van, plus proper homemade woodfired pizza, hog roast, and local eggs and chocolates 🪺 

We lurvved the pizzas and cider (and he loved the apple cannons even more 🍎 🎯😆)

Spilman’s Farm 📌 YO7 3NB

#autumn #yorkshire #pumpkinpatch #pumpkinpatchuk #cosyseason *invite

An enchanting fairy sanctuary with a woodland walk and a magnificently cosy autumnal afternoon tea 🧚‍♀️ 

This is such a heartwarming place and it feels like diving headfirst into a classic storybook 📚 

The edible “mushroom” meringues and cakes were almost too cute to eat but eat them we did, walking it all off on the fairy trail afterwards ✨ There is also an enchanted maze you can spend a lazy weekend getting lost in 👀 

Dreamery Gardens, near York 🏰 

*inspired by the beautiful video by the fabulous @the.yorkshireman #yorkshire #yorkshirefood #explore #afternoontea #york @dreamery.gardens

BUCCAL HAS LANDED IN HEADINGLEY ❤️

Never heard of it?

The world-renowned facial lifting and jaw release treatment works from INSIDE the mouth (intraoral) to release muscular tension of the jaw, face & temples.

This softens folds, sculpts the face and floods the tissues with nutrients through improved circulation 🤍 

The end result? A lifted face, softer lines and a calmer mind 😴 

I must admit, the thought of having a stranger’s fingers in my mouth (granted with gloves) did fill me with a sense of trepidation. This is a highly unusual treatment! But the results speak for themselves.

My therapist Natalja made it all so comfortable and I felt a strong sense of release afterwards, like I’d finally shrugged off something heavy I didn’t even know I was carrying around.

Even after one treatment I am in awe of the results not just in terms of general lift but skin quality.

📚 🌈 Leeds stationery lovers, this one’s for you 🎨 

There’s a new Autumnal range 🎃 plus a gorgeous build your own custom notebook station @fabulous.planning with only the pages you want ❤️ 

Expect pumpkin spice totes, ghost-themed notebooks, autumnal leaf designs plus a load of gorgeous gifts 🍁 👻 

The Build-A-Book experience is £15, but if you manage to leave without spending more, we salute you!

📌 Fabulous Planning, The Corn Exchange, LS1 7BR

#leeds #cornexchange #stationery #leedsindependents #stationeryshop

I’ll take my chances 🤚 

If anyone has been living in a bin and hasn’t heard of @bigbunsuk yet, they don’t play about with their double smashburgers and fries 🔥

Two juicy patties smashed on the flat top, caremelised onions, melted cheese, house pickles and their burger sauce.

Serving them up Monday - Sunday, a must-try if you haven’t already 🍔

🌸 🍰 Yorkshire’s answer to Peggy Porschen has arrived 🧁 🌸✨

One of West Yorkshire’s most beautiful cafes is a 20 minute drive from Leeds, and I still can’t get over not hearing about this place before now 🥹

Pemberley’s Lofthouse is pink, delicious and open for brunch, lunch, dinner and Sunday Roasts 🤫 🎀 

(as well as cakes and pretty cocktails of course 🧁)

@pemberleyslofthouse 182 Leeds Road, WF3 3LR 📍 

#leedsfoodie #yorkshirefoodie #coffeeshop #wakefield #beautifuldestinations

@blankstreet launching ice cream w/a crisp chocolate shell 💚 Yikes the queues!! 

All made with actual real ingredients, no processed sugars - just sweetened with a touch of honey 🍯 

My fave was the strawberry shortcake flavour 🍓 

launching soon in select stores only!

#foodie #leeds #leedsfoodie #recommended #coffeeshop

A book lover’s dream half an hour from Leeds 📚 ✨ 

This place is the most beautiful book shop I have ever visited in my life. It truly feels like stepping into a fairytale and everything looks meticulous in a Venetian Gothic style 🖤🌚

Follow me @amyzingfinds_ for activities, food and travel 🧳 🗺️ 

They have a wide collection of books, games, unique stationery and gifts, plus the upstairs cafe is nothing short of stunning ❤️👌🏻

I highly recommend checking it out, sticking around to grab a coffee and cake at the cafe, catch up on some work or just take in the surroundings 🤗

📍 Waterstones, The Wool Exchange, Hustlergate, BD1 1BL

#bookstore #bradford #leeds #explore #beautifuldestinations

Move over Jaws 😳 🎣

Just an hour from Leeds, Pocklington is home to its own kind of aquatic mystery.

Follow me @amyzingfinds_ for activities, food and travel 🧳 🗺️ 

Burnby Hall Gardens and Museum is a unique day out whether you’re a nature lover or just want to feed these amazing fish and stop for a homemade cake and coffee ☕️ 🍰 

The Upper Lake at this scenic escape is home to thousands of Carp, Roach and Rudd and they love being fed! You can purchase specialist fish feed at the entrance for a nominal fee 😊

This charming area also boats over 100 varieties of water lillies 🪷🪷

There’s also a handmade Victorian rock garden, a walled garden, an Aviary 🐦 and a giant redwood trunk brought from America 🇺🇸 @burnbyhallgardens 

#yorkshire #visityorkshire #uktravelblogger #visitleeds #fishfeeding

LA meet LEEDS ✨ 🤩💓 

This new viral late-night dessert shop is doing a roaring trade.

And it’s healthy 😉

I’ve been meaning to get my butt down to this place & it was so so worth the wait.
If you’ve not heard of it yet - @kefi.yo specialise in frozen kefir (basically gorgeous tasting ice cream but made with with gut-loving kefir🍦)

I went for the plain and baby pink coconut flavours (the colour is so cute 😍) with a load of fresh fruit, PB and coconut flakes.

Verdict: gorgeously tangy and refreshing. 

Fair warning we both got the large and hoovered them up in record time so only downside is they’re a bit too addictive.

Have you been yet & which flavour combos did you go for? 🤤 

📌 Kefiyo, 17 Ash Road, Headingley, LS6 3JJ

⏰ 10am - 11pm every day 

#leeds #leedslife #visitleeds #whatsoninleeds #leedsnewopening

Dreamy candlelit dinner at the sumptuous @thewhitehallleeds 😍🕯️

Particularly enjoyed the scallops & the colourful cocktail selection. Dishes we tried included:

- Snowball French onion soup with cheddar croute 🧀 

- ⁠Scottish king scallops with heritage tomatoes & curd (my personal fave 👌🏻) 

- ⁠Duo of West Moor pork (confit belly and stuffed loin) 🐽 

- ⁠Sticky toffee pud with salted toffee sauce & black treacle ice cream 🖤

For £38 per person you get:

- 3 course meal, plus
- ⁠1/2 a bottle of wine each🥂 

(Um literally a steal👌🏻👀)

This menu runs 5-7pm Monday to Saturday (unlike most deals which exclude the weekend 💃 🪩)

#leeds #lifeinleeds #leedsdiaries #leedsrestaurants #wheretogo

If you live in Leeds and haven’t been here, I was honestly mesmerised ✨ 

The colours and choice of homeware is staggering ❤️ 💜 💛 

@mondego_outlet is right by the river on the outskirts of the city and the bare brick aesthetic interiors are so beautiful. 

We spent wayyy too long in here and I’m already planning when to go back 🫣

The coffee cups were my favourite but the pastel bowls are irresistible too, and they also have super cute loungewear and dressing gowns.

I’ve already decided that all of my friends are getting Christmas pressies from here 🎀 

Everything is dishwasher safe even the oven dishes and large scalloped serving plates (ranging from £6-19)

📍 Mondego, Roundhouse Business Park, LS12 1AH

🚘 There’s a small car park (which we had no problem finding a spot at) but Mondego is also a really pleasant stroll down the river if you live centrally 💡
Chew, chew and then chew again ☀️ The Seceda in the Italian Alps absolutely took my breath away and I think about this moment so often 🥹❤️ #life #wellness #travel #dolomites #inspirational

Who would you gift this Totoro purse to? 🥹💕 

POV: You stumble upon a historic shop with the prettiest purses in the world 🌺 (then find out they have an online store 😳)

Think Studio Ghibli, Harry Potter, Totoro and Bertie Botts Every Flavour Bean handbags⚡️ 

The shop is hidden away from the main street so you’d only find it if you were really looking 👀 
I wanted every single one of these purses and had to literally be dragged out of the shop 😂

These are exceptionally high quality traditional Japanese hand-painted leather beauties, all painted by Japanese artisans with matching linings and clasps. Each purse and clutch has its own unique design (including Totoro 🥹)

📍 Bunkoya-Oozeki Asakusa Store (and available online 🤫)

Have you actually seen a more stunning Indian restaurant? 

Located a stone’s throw from Leeds Playhouse Theatre, Kerala Canteen is something pretty special. The Kerala chefs here competed in @masterchefuk and @greatbritishmenu and the food is seriously top tier ✨ 

All the fish, meat and veggies are sourced locally in Yorkshire ❤️ and there are fun Yorkshire twists on South Indian dishes (beef curry Yorkshire pie anyone? 😂)

#southindianfood #dosalover #foodreels #visitleeds #leedsfoodie

If this isn’t Leeds’ best bakery I don’t know where is 👀

It’s over at Leeds Docks just by the Royal Armouries museum and their pastries and sourdough are utter perfection ✨

Crumble buns, decadent croissants, country sourdough, cinnamon sugar madeleines, ooey-gooey salted caramel brownies, the list goes on and on 🤤 It’s the perfect sweet treat spot in Leeds and it’s called Nova Bakehouse 🧁 you can also pick up amazing coffee, dark hot chocolate and local organic products while you’re there 🥹

#leeds #sweettreat #bakery #leedsfood #leedsfoodie

If it’s good enough for Nadiya Hussain and Fred Sirieix 😉

Honestly this place is packed to the bloomin’ rafters every single night for all the right reasons.

I’ve been buying Indian fried snacks from these guys for years but they are one of the most talked about spots in Leeds atm so some friendly advice to call ahead if you want to secure some of their glorious samosas 👀 

Nadiya Hussain has famously said their samosas are the very best she’s tried - and I 💯 agree (even the ones we tried in India weren’t a match 😭)

The rotating thali plate is soo flavourful but the size of a small child so would advise training your stomach if you go 😂

📍 Anand Sweets, 53-55 Queen’s Road, Leeds, LS6 1HY (they also have an original shop in Harehills)

Have you visited this Leeds brunch spot yet? ❤️

What a total vibe: I am ashamed to admit that I hadn’t even heard of @groundedandco.leeds but we popped in for brunch and caffeine (obvs) and now I’m so addicted to their mango cloud matcha it’s going to be a weekly thing 🤤

What I like about these guys is they source everything as locally as possible and are super picky about their beans - sourcing their coffee from the mighty @echeloncoffee 🙌 

Anything on a menu with focaccia is like a moth to flame with me so would highly recommend the focaccia sandos @leedsbreadcoop 🥖 

Perk: they also have free yoga session every Monday at 12 with the lovely @tashberry_yoga 🧘‍♀️

#leeds #leedslife #leedsfoodie #leedscoffee #leedscoffeeshop

Cool off, relax and recover 🧘‍♂️

4 ice baths, 3 saunas (including a silent sauna 🤫) and a cafe where you can grab an iced coffee, matcha or cooling electrolyte drink.

45 minute sessions are £12 or you can treat yourself to a longer 90 minute experience for £20.

Welcome to…
Folkestone, Kent 🇬🇧 

Follow me @amyzingfinds_ for more UK and abroad content ❤️ 

This is one of the prettiest coastal towns in England, and it honestly feels like you’ve been transported to the Mediterranean coast 🥹

With colourful boats, azul-blue water, rainbow houses and plenty of outdoor pursuits, it’s easy to see why this place has such a vibe in the summer ☀️ 

Here’s my mini-guide to visiting:

Located in the South-East of England, Folkestone is 1 hour on the train from London and just over 2 hours drive. If you’re visiting by car, there are parking options in town but they can fill up quickly especially at weekends, so arriving early is a good idea!

For the best views of the famous white cliffs, head up to Folkestone Warren, where you’ll get a panoramic view of the surrounding coastline.

The atmosphere in Leeds in the run up to the England v Norway game is amazing.

Seems @projecthouselds is one of the best places to be for watching FIFA World Cup!

#england #worldcup #leeds #threelions #worldcup2026
